_about: Public-domain John Sharshall Grasty (1825-1883), Presbyterian minister, for the Word Hoard: the Memoir of Rev. Samuel B. McPheeters, Faith's Battles and Victories, The Way to Zion, and his tracts A Noble Testimony and A Great Question Asked. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 119 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
